content.short: Audita provides future-proof smart contract audits for Web3, ensuring user safety and security.
content.description: Audita acts as a security partner for Web3 protocols and dApps, advancing the blockchain ecosystem through persistent research, rigorous exploit simulations, and proactive prevention. Its team of smart contract auditing experts collaborates with teams across projects to safeguard funds from hackers and to guide the creation of state-of-the-art, secure, and gas-optimized smart contracts that align with current industry standards and best practices.
